name: WebRTC Video
description: Peer-to-peer WebRTC video calls and voice channels for Mattermost.

settings_schema.header: Peer-to-peer video calls and voice channels. Media flows directly between browsers; this server only relays signalling. Configure STUN/TURN so users behind NAT or firewalls can connect.

settings.help_text: STUN server to use for calls, conforming to RFC 3489, RFC 5389, RFC 5780 and others. Enter as 'stun:<hostname>:<port>'. STUN server should usually have public IP address and is used for NAT traversal. Example: stun:stun.example.com:3498

TURN server to use for calls, conforming to RFC 5766, RFC 6062 and others. Enter as 'turn:<hostname>:<port>'. TURN server may be used for transferring video stream in case both peers are behind NAT. Example: turn:turn.example.com:3498
Static TURN username. Ignored when a TURN shared secret is set.
Static TURN credential (password). Ignored when a TURN shared secret is set.

Recommended. Shared secret for time-limited TURN credentials (TURN REST API, coturn `use-auth-secret` / `static-auth-secret`). When set, each user receives a short-lived username/password derived from this secret instead of the static credential above.
How long generated TURN credentials remain valid. Only used with a TURN shared secret. Minimum 60, default 720 (12 hours).

settings_schema.footer: * To report an issue, make a suggestion or a contribution, [check the repository](https://github.com/niklabh/mattermost-plugin-webrtc-video).
